firm_data.firm_description: Gary Tsirelman, P.C. is a law firm in Brooklyn, NY.

email.subject: AI for Gary Tsirelman, P.C. - built for firms like yours
email.body:
Hi Gary,

Your practice spans estate, accident and injury, and dispute resolution work that demands precision and client trust, especially as a solo attorney managing multiple complex areas.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms that face BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of smaller practices: accuracy, client confidence, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now arriving in Brooklyn to meet regional firms. I'd be happy to stop by your office to share how, as ex-lawyers ourselves, we're helping similar practices compete with larger competitors.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
